name: a15w
description: The definitive skill extension pack for AI coding agents. 7 specialized pipelines. 61 stages. 322 validation checks. Zero tolerance for hallucinations. Maximum code quality velocity.
author: dev2k6

skills.name: code_review_pipeline
skills.description: CORE SKILL. 8-stage ordered review pipeline. Evaluates AI-generated code from macro-architecture to micro-syntax. Catches hallucinations, verifies dependencies exist, checks edge cases, audits database patterns, enforces security, validates against prompt constraints. Aborts on critical failures.

skills.name: security_audit
skills.description: 10-stage critical-first security audit. Hardcoded secrets, injection flaws, auth bypass, XSS, crypto weaknesses, data exposure, dependency CVEs, misconfigurations. Stops immediately on FATAL issues. Production secrets = pipeline abort.

skills.name: test_generation
skills.description: 8-stage comprehensive test generation. Edge cases, error paths, integration scenarios, property-based invariants. Real tests that assert actual behavior. Rejects trivial mocks like expect(true).toBe(true).

skills.name: refactor_safety
skills.description: 8-stage behavioral equivalence validation. Refactored code must produce identical outputs, side effects, and error conditions. Same database writes, same API calls, same exceptions. Refactoring must not change observable behavior.

skills.name: dependency_audit
skills.description: 8-stage supply chain security audit. CVEs, license conflicts, abandoned packages, duplicate dependencies, bundle size impact, update risk assessment. Know what's in your node_modules before attackers do.

skills.name: api_contract_validation
skills.description: 9-stage OpenAPI/Swagger compliance validator. Every endpoint, method, status code, request schema, response schema, error response, authentication flow. Spec fidelity enforced. No undocumented behavior allowed.

skills.name: performance_profiling
skills.description: 10-stage bottleneck identification. N+1 queries, memory leaks, blocking I/O, hot paths, GC pressure, concurrency issues, database performance, caching analysis. Measure first, optimize second. Quantify before you optimize.

categories.quality: Code quality and correctness validation (core: code_review_pipeline, refactor_safety, api_contract_validation)
categories.security: Security vulnerability detection and prevention (security_audit, dependency_audit)

pipeline_philosophy.critical_principle: Macro to Micro, Critical to Cosmetic, Verify not Trust, Measure not Guess
